CustomField.description: BR-15, BR-16, PD-12. THE SELLER INPUT that records an explicit decline of the Marketing handoff: populating it IS the act of rejecting, which is why no separate checkbox exists to become a second source of the same fact. RESTRICTED picklist - a governed vocabulary is assessable by a later control where free-form notes are not, and each value routes to a different upstream owner. On a valid rejection Lead_Inbound_Before_Save writes the timestamp, the authenticated actor and the versioned basis, and it refuses the save unless an accountable individual owner holds the Lead - a coverage queue can no more decline a handoff than accept one. NOT disqualification, NOT Closed - Not Converted, and NOT lifecycle regression: the Lead remains MQL. Not a general disposition field, and not to be repurposed for outcomes it was never governed to express.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Why Sales declined this handoff. Selecting a reason records the rejection.
CustomField.label: Sales Rejection Reason
